# SAT Hub

> Simplified SAT prep, peer community, and international scholarships for global scholars.

SAT Hub helps students master the SAT through bite-sized "cheat codes," a supportive peer forum, and a curated pipeline of international scholarship opportunities.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SAT Hub and what the platform offers.
- [Impact](/impact): Mission, outcomes, and community impact.
- [Join](/auth): Create an account or log in to access the full platform.
